extra.message: Affected versions of org.assertj:assertj-core are vulnerable to Improper Restriction of XML External Entity Reference. An XXE vulnerability exists in AssertJ's XmlStringPrettyFormatter.toXmlDocument(String), which initializes DocumentBuilderFactory with default settings (DTD and external entities enabled). If untrusted XML is passed to isXmlEqualTo(CharSequence) or xmlPrettyFormat(String), an attacker can read local files, perform SSRF, or trigger DoS via entity expansion.
